title: Active Ragdoll
cue: physical hit reactions, stumbles, knock-downs, getting up
summary: Active ragdolls for humanoid skeletons: muscles drive physical bones toward the animation, so characters flinch, stagger, fall, lie hurt, and get up along a clip.
useWhen: Characters must react to hits and shoves with their bodies: flinch, stagger and step to catch themselves, get knocked down, lie hurt, or get up, instead of only playing a clip or going limp.
avoidWhen: The body only has to fall limp once, which drop-in-ragdoll does with less setup, or the skeleton does not use Godot's humanoid bone names.
